verdicts.reason: A shrinks the original leaderboard into a thin strip across the middle of the square canvas. About 85% of the canvas is blank white, nothing is rearranged for the square format, and the text is small, but the headline, URL and logo stay intact and readable. B is the same shrunk strip with worse damage: the headline, URL and 'HO SMART' wordmark are gone, and the logo icon floats as a faint white outline on white above the band. The ad has no message at all.
